query: create table if not exists forms (id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), title text not null, description text, metadata jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb, created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null, updated_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null); create table if not exists responses (id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), form_id uuid references forms(id) on delete cascade not null, answers jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb, submitted_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null); alter table forms enable row level security; alter table responses enable row level security; drop policy if exists "Public forms are viewable by everyone" on forms; drop policy if exists "Public forms can be created by everyone" on forms; drop policy if exists "Public forms can be updated by everyone" on forms; drop policy if exists "Responses are viewable by everyone" on responses; drop policy if exists "Responses can be created by everyone" on responses; create policy "Public forms are viewable by everyone" on forms for select using (true); create policy "Public forms can be created by everyone" on forms for insert with check (true); create policy "Public forms can be updated by everyone" on forms for update using (true); create policy "Responses are viewable by everyone" on responses for select using (true); create policy "Responses can be created by everyone" on responses for insert with check (true);
